problem_statement: V2K is a new experimental candidate, not a retune or promotion of V2J. It tests whether a market-blind hierarchical team-strength layer, a drive-level integer scoring process, an explicit real final-regulation-possession mechanism, and one shared joint score path distribution can reproduce football score structure and support coherent ML/spread/total pricing. Uploaded prototype coefficients and stand-in key-number checks are engineering demonstrations only and have no fitted or promotion authority.

final_regulation_possession.fit_policy: Categorical probabilities estimated from real historical final regulation possessions in the frozen training interval only. No coefficient may be selected to hit a key-number frequency.

architecture.key_number_policy: Historical key-number frequencies are validation diagnostics only. They may not be a loss term, fitting target, coefficient target, hyperparameter criterion, candidate-selection objective, or manual tuning target.

forbidden_inputs: historical key-number frequencies as fitting or selection targets
V2J or earlier candidate residuals as numeric tuning targets
2026 outcomes for fitting, selection, or backfill

data_boundary.source_policy: Exact nflverse source URLs, release identifiers, file hashes, row counts, and extraction rules must be frozen in the V2K source manifest before the first fitted readout.

frozen_extraction_policy.final_regulation_possession_definition: Last regulation offensive drive for each game represented by a non-null drive identifier and possession team, using the final play state of that drive for score delta. Administrative rows without a possession team do not create drives.
frozen_extraction_policy.game_final_score_source: nflverse schedule/game result data or final PBP scoreboard, with exact choice and hash recorded before readout

attempt_budget.software_bug_fix_policy: Before the first historical fitted readout, implementation-only fixes that make code conform to this preregistration are permitted and must be ledgered. After the first readout, any change capable of changing statistical behavior requires a new candidate ID and preregistration.

frozen_evaluation_gates.mc_precision_definition: For each priced Bernoulli win event, SE=sqrt(p*(1-p)/n); report event-specific SE and maximum. Margin-point standard error may not substitute for probability SE.
